scenes.audio: A bright, digital notification chime sounds, followed by upbeat, mid-tempo electronic background music featuring soft synth melodies.
scenes.label: Opening Hook
scenes.visual: A static digital screenshot of a software landing page. The background is a crisp white with a central hero section featuring a blue and white abstract logo. Below the logo, a large download button is centered. The lighting is bright and even, mimicking a standard high-resolution monitor display. The color palette is dominated by professional blues, whites, and soft grays.

scenes.audio: The upbeat electronic music continues at a steady volume. A subtle 'whoosh' sound effect accompanies the scroll transition.
scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.visual: The screen transitions via a vertical scroll to show a white information panel. On the left, a partial view of a software interface is visible, showing a document list. On the right, clean black text describes collaboration features. A gray button with a small arrow icon is positioned at the bottom of the text block.

scenes.audio: The music continues. A sharp, mechanical 'click' sound effect triggers as the pill-shaped button appears on screen.
scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.visual: The camera pans slightly right to focus on a large, bold text block in the center of the frame. Below the main description, a dark gray pill-shaped button appears with white text inside. The background remains a clean, minimalist white with soft drop shadows under the text containers.

scenes.audio: The background music persists. Another 'whoosh' sound effect plays during the vertical transition.
scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.visual: The screen scrolls vertically again to a new section. On the left, a software dashboard showing permission settings is visible. On the right, a chat interface mockup shows profile icons (a green circle with a stylized bird logo and a blue circle with a silhouette) alongside message bubbles. The aesthetic remains high-contrast and professional.

scenes.audio: The electronic music maintains its tempo. A final 'click' sound effect plays as the button appears, followed by a quick fade-out of the audio.
scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.visual: A final slight zoom into the text block on the right. A dark gray pill-shaped button with white text pops into view at the bottom of the screen, mirroring the animation style from Scene 3. The layout is balanced with plenty of white space.
